reviews.title: Don’t trust Best Buy or the people that work there
reviews.comment: Bought a new gaming pc that came with technical issues.  I didn’t have time to go back but when I did it was past 20 days and told me I had to pay to fix a faulty pc that they sold me so basically I scammed.  I also bought other items that just simply don’t work.  The worst experience ever.  Big major companies are just scamming people we need to stop spending money on these big companies.
